name: AutoPost — publish to Facebook via Blotato

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes:
The only node you edit by hand.
blotatoAccountId / blotatoPageId — or clear the expressions on the Blotato publish node and pick both from its dropdowns instead.
facebookVideoMode — 'reel' or 'video'. Ignored for image posts.

nodes.name: Get new rows
nodes.notes: Fetches ONLY rows whose `post status` is still "queued" — Apps Script writes that on every new row. Approval (`status = Publish`) is checked downstream, because this filter is what keeps the sweep from growing with the sheet.

nodes.name: Mark processing
nodes.notes: Claims the row in the automation column so an overlapping sweep can't publish it twice. The human `status` column is left alone.

nodes.name: Blotato upload media
nodes.notes: Runs once per media item. URL upload, not binary — the node's own note says to use a URL for Google Drive files (up to ~60 MB).

nodes.name: Blotato publish
nodes.notes: facebookMediaType resolves to '' for images, which the node treats as unset — mediaType only applies to video. Returns { postSubmissionId }.

nodes.name: Wait for publish
nodes.notes: Blotato publishes asynchronously — give it a moment before asking for the outcome.

assignments.name: result
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const ig = $('Build post payload').item.json.ignored || []; const drop = $('Build post payload').item.json.uploadErrors ? 'MEDIA DROPPED (' + $('Build post payload').item.json.uploadErrors + ') | ' : ''; const extra = ig.length ? ' | ignored platforms: ' + ig.join(', ') : ''; const sub = $('Blotato publish').item.json.postSubmissionId || ''; if ($json.status === 'published') return drop + 'facebook: posted (' + ($('Build post payload').item.json.mediaCount || 1) + ' media) — ' + ($json.publicUrl || 'no url returned') + extra; if ($json.status === 'failed') return drop + 'facebook: FAILED — ' + ($json.errorMessage || 'no reason given') + extra; if ($json.error) return drop + 'facebook: submitted — status check failed (' + String($json.error) + '), submission ' + sub + extra; return drop + 'facebook: submitted — still in progress, submission ' + sub + extra; })() }}

nodes.name: Due yet?
nodes.notes: Compares the sheet's publish time to now. Rows that aren't due yet are left alone — NOT marked processing or failed — so the next sweep re-checks them.

nodes.name: Nothing to do
nodes.notes: Dead end on purpose — the row is either already handled or not due yet. Nothing is written, so the next sweep re-checks it.

nodes.name: Approved?
nodes.notes: True only when a human has moved `status` to "Publish" AND `post status` is still "queued". Everything else is left completely untouched so the next sweep re-checks it.

nodes.name: Split media
nodes.notes: Fans a row out to one item per media URL so the upload node can process a carousel.

nodes.name: Collect media
nodes.notes: Rebuilds one item per row with mediaUrls back in carousel order.
